reason: STATUS CONFIRMED, REASON REPLACED. The standing reason on this frame and ~34 siblings is "there is no post entity in the database". That is true of Postgres and FALSE of the system, so it has been pointing every reader at a schema design that is not the work. Measured 2026-09-01 against the live chain and the live indexer. THE POST ENTITY EXISTS AND IS ROUTED: SKAISocialFeed.sol:243 declares createPost(bytes32 contentHash, uint256 parentId) with struct Post at :93 and event PostCreated at :161; indexer/ingester/ingester.go:4633 builds sktypes.SocialPost and :4642 calls PutSocialPost; indexer/store/store.go:3069 persists it under prefixSocialPost; indexer/api/rest/server.go:781 routes GET /api/v1/social/feed, and https://indexer.skai.trade/api/v1/social/feed?limit=5 answers HTTP 200 {"success":true,"data":[],"pagination":{"total":0}}. THE ACTUAL BLOCKER IS A BRICKED PREDEPLOY SET: eth_getCode on 0x5B41...0090 / 0091 / 0092 / 0093 returns the SAME 55-byte word on all four, 0x7f360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc545f365f5f855af43d5f5f3e6029573d5ff35b3d5ffd, and every eth_call reverts with "execution reverted: stack underflow (5 <=> 6)". The disassembly explains it exactly: PUSH32 slot, SLOAD, PUSH0, CALLDATASIZE, PUSH0, PUSH0, DUP6 - DUP6 needs six stack items and finds five, so the stub reverts on ANY calldata and the implementation it points at is irrelevant. The ERC-1967 slot 0x360894...382bbc reads 0x...1090 / 1091 / 1092 / 1093 respectively, and each of those four addresses ALSO holds the identical 55-byte stub. Controls on the same RPC in the same minute: sUSD 0x5B41...0002 holds 6207 bytes and decimals() answers 0x06; eth_blockNumber 0x6f3b0d. So the RPC is healthy and only the social set is dead. THE ITEM IS A REDEPLOY, NOT A SCHEMA DESIGN - and it is necessary but NOT sufficient: contentHash is a bytes32 IPFS CID with no uploader anywhere in src (src/components/social/post/storyMedia.ts:19-20 records the same absence), so a post body still has nowhere to live.

The indexer route is live and answers 200/total 0.
